name: Bern held-out routing benchmark
description: Realistic English / Taglish messages written independently of the training data. 'dev' items are used for error analysis while training; 'test' items are only scored for the final report. expected intent 'unknown' means Bern must say it does not know (needs_training=true). 'test2' was written after the first full training run, before any rejection-threshold tuning: a fresh hold-out scored once at the end.
